Subject: FinTechCo — discovery recap & next steps

Hi Priya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan.

Key takeaways from your side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and tail latency for real-time payment authorizations (median latency target < 80ms).
- Constraints: must run in customers' private VPC, strict audit logs for PCI compliance, and predictable monthly spend for budgeting.
- Current pain: unpredictable token costs with current provider and limited ability to do dedicated reserved capacity.

How Redwood helps (high level):
- Dedicated pools + autoscaling for predictable throughput and lower p95 latency.
- KV/prefix caching and quantization options to reduce per-token cost on inference-heavy flows.
- Private deployment options and audit logging integrations for compliance.

Proposed next steps:
1) Tech deep-dive / SE session to validate integration approach and SSO/KMS requirements (30–45 mins) — suggested owners: Rishi.
2) 2-week POC focused on the authorization path with a small reserved GPU footprint (contracted trial, success criteria: p95 latency < 150ms, per-authorization cost reduction >= 30%).
3) If POC looks good, discuss Dedicated sizing and enterprise contract for Q3.

Attachments: FinTechCo-MAP.pdf (mutual action plan), discovery-call-recording.mp3
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DF-2027-0042

Would you be open to scheduling the SE deep-dive next week? I can do Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks,
